text: Choose a simple action or small ritual that symbolically completes the day. For example, put your phone on charge in the same place (just not by the bed), turn on “do not disturb” mode, turn the screen face down. And after that, no “just one more minute.” This is a small boundary that you can easily draw. But it teaches the psyche: night is an alternative life (and maybe a little death), it is the territory of mystical experience, it is the time when your body rests and the psyche recovers. After just a week you will notice fewer anxious awakenings at night and more calm in the mornings.
